profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at USAA
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with fifteen years of experience in development and support.  Quick learner with excellent analytical and problem solving skills involved in designing and developing complex software applications.  Interested in software architecture and system design.

Specialties: Java, Ada, C/C++
Eclipse, IntelliJ, Visual Studio
Agile and traditional development methodologies.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description: Partner with the Financial Crimes business teams to understand the automation needs.  Research viable technical options to develop system solutions and design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and develop back-end Java software application for the Payments Platform.
• Deploy software application to the Websphere Application Server environment.
• Utilize Spring framework with Java Persistence API to add/update data objects in DB2 database and leverage SOAP/REST web services to communicate with external software systems.
• Design and develop JSR 352 batch jobs with JDBC/JPA for periodic payments processing.
• Perform Agile development methodology practices for continuous development and delivery.
• Continuously integrate with GitLab CI.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop Ada code to add or improve functionality to the existing embedded CDU (Cockpit Display Unit) and MFD (Multi-Function Display) software.  Generate software components to utilize XML-RPC protocol to communicate with external partitions via HTTP
• Generate a software architecture diagram of an application used in multiple projects to initiate a product-line approach, allowing it to evolve as a configurable and reusable component (Enterprise Architect)
• Develop Java and C/C++ components as services to be implemented with the OSGi (Open Service Gateway initiative) framework
• Serve as subject-matter expert to prepare customer bids and participate in project planning.  Provide Software SLOC estimates and utilize department metrics for the required development methodology to accurately forecast budget and schedule (SEER-SEM and BidMaster)
• Conduct unit testing to verify functionality and performance of software components.  Monitor and verify Mil-1553STD messages generated by the software to ensure accurate communication with the radio
• Participate in requirements and source code peer reviews to enhance the quality of the system
• Generate Software Detailed Design documentation, from high level customer requirements, to be utilized during the software development phase and delivered to the end customer as a reference guide.  Develop sequence and activity diagrams in Enterprise Architect and imported them into DOORs as visual representations of the description.   Update low level software requirements to meet customer requirements and verify requirements traceability to ensure appropriate coverage of system requirements
• Support cross-team projects with implementation of Customer Requests to fix reported code bugs and/or add enhancements.  Participate in After Action Reviews to discuss and improve the software development process for future projects.  Generated white papers as reference for new technology/process discovered through various projects

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Help design, develop, and debug custom LotusScript and Java applications as well as web services to increase flexibility of Lotus database management system that will allow end users to customize databases and applications as desired to improve efficiency and functionality (Java, LotusScript, JavaScript, and XML)
• Debug, decode, and test Lotus Domino server application, using Visual Studio .Net, to find and report software bugs allowing the Lotus development team to improve the software (C/C++)
• Assist external customers maintain existing custom databases as well as review security settings for Domino server to eliminate malicious activities and scripts

positions.title: Help Desk Analyst
positions.description: • Provide technical support for internal employees with various issues including network connectivity, email, software installation as well as basic application and network management to allow users the abilities to perform their job duties and improve productivity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, develop, implement and maintain an application that automates the creation and delivery of switch update patches using VB, XML, and ASP to help reduce customer support turnaround time. Automate the system to generate and store reports pertaining to these patches
• Conduct prototype demonstration and operator training on software automation’s graphical user interfaces resulting in better understanding of the software and reduction in errors
• Setup and maintain the server and database, as well as automate administrative duties to handle future system changes and website updates (NT Server 4.0, ASP, XML, IIS, and DCOM components)
• Standardize reports for various cellular systems by creating an administration system, which allowed the engineers to set up and administer different system requirements using one application
